The meter view law of omx_meter_view.h at the oracle rates and quanta 32 to 1024: held, a burst read at hostReadHz, its fill and the marker stepped by the time since the last read; gr, the deepest reduction kept between reads and the reading recovered by omx_meter_gr_step over that time; fall, the marker after full scale at each draw rate; ladder, clip, fillDb, fillLinear and decimate, the rest of the law.
